_why: WSG-1. The 6a-prime evidence gate was `tools == 0` -- a floor of ZERO -- while this channel's own contract costs one successful call ('you must also WRITE your report file with run_command. That is the only write you may make'). A reviewer that read nothing and merely obeyed the delivery instruction scored tools=1 and its READY_TO_MERGE was recorded for the Phase-7 gate to read. `h_mad_audit_cycle` has carried DELIVERY_FLOOR = 2 against the same J49 failure; one channel was guarded and the other was not. Each mutation carries its own `test` key.

mutations.name: the-floor-is-zero-again
mutations._mechanism: The state before this change. A clean verdict resting on the delivery call alone is recorded, and nothing downstream can tell it from a review that read the tree.

mutations.name: the-floor-is-off-by-one-and-refuses-real-reviews
mutations._mechanism: The opposite failure, and the one a test asserting only the refusal would miss: a gate that rejects every review is abandoned within a day, and 6a-prime goes back to being run by hand with no gate at all.

mutations.name: the-floor-is-applied-to-every-verdict
mutations._mechanism: Drops the asymmetry. Findings are evidence of reading and a clean is not; refusing a WITH_FIXES or NO at the same count discards review work that was actually done -- the exact failure the report-file channel was built to stop, reintroduced by the gate meant to protect it.

mutations.name: the-refused-clean-is-recorded-anyway
mutations._mechanism: Halting but recording is worse than not halting: the operator sees a refusal while the Phase-7 gate reads READY_TO_MERGE out of the state file. A test asserting only the token and the exit code would pass here.

mutations.name: the-floor-swallows-the-zero-case
mutations._mechanism: NO_EVIDENCE is the stronger claim -- nothing ran at all, for ANY verdict -- and its halt is what SKILL.md asserts on. Letting the new gate absorb it makes a zero-call WITH_FIXES pass.

mutations.name: the-contract-stops-bounding-the-write-count
mutations._mechanism: The floor of 1 rests on one sentence in the shipped template. If the contract grows a second required write and the constant does not follow, the gate silently goes one call too permissive -- which is the original defect at a higher number.
mutations.find: That is the only write you may make.
mutations.replace: You may also write a .done marker beside it.
